'''André Lévy-Lang''' ({{IPA|fr|ɑ̃dʁˈe lˈe͡ɪvi-lˈɑ̃ɡ|lang}}; 26 November 1937 – 8 August 2026) was a French private banker.<ref>{{cite news |last=Hidalgo|first=Clara|date=10 August 2026|title=Décès d’André Lévy-Lang, dernier patron de Paribas|url=https://www.lefigaro.fr/decideurs/deces-d-andre-levy-lang-dernier-patron-de-paribas-20260810|trans-title= |work=[[Le Figaro]]|language=French|location= |publisher= |access-date=10 August 2026}}</ref>

A graduate of the [[École polytechnique]] and [[Stanford University]], he served as chairman of the board of directors of the [[Compagnie Bancaire]] and subsequently of [[BNP Paribas]].<ref>{{cite news |last= |first= |date=28 September 2000|title=André Lévy-Lang renvoyé en correctionnelle|url=https://www.nouvelobs.com/economie/20000928.OBS7763/andre-levy-lang-renvoye-en-correctionnelle.html|trans-title= |work=[[Le Nouvel Obs|Le Nouvel Observateur]]|language=French|location= |publisher= |access-date=10 August 2026}}</ref> He was a member of the think tank [[Le Siècle (think tank)|Le Siècle]] and a member of the steering committee of the [[Bilderberg Meeting]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.bilderbergmeetings.org/former-steering-committee-members.html|title=Former Steering Committee Members|work=Bilderberg Meeting|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20100703154117/http://www.bilderbergmeetings.org/former-steering-committee-members.html|archivedate=3 July 2010}}</ref>

Lévy-Lang died on 8 August 2026, at the age of 88.<ref>{{cite news |last=Brière|first=Marie|date=10 August 2026|title=André Lévy-Lang: A Founding Figure of the Institut Louis Bachelier Has Passed Away|url=https://www.institutlouisbachelier.org/en/on-the-program/actualites/andre-levy-lang-une-figure-fondatrice-de-linstitut-louis-bachelier-nous-a-quittes|trans-title= |work=Institut Louis Bachelier|language= |location= |publisher= |access-date=10 August 2026}}</ref>

==Works==
*''L'Argent, la Finance et le Risque'' (2006)
*''Il faut maîtriser la Finance'' (2012)
*''La Révolution de la finance : acte II'' (2019)
